description: This file manages model pricing cache for a gateway, including fetching model data from an external API, parsing pricing info, caching, and refresh logic.

methods.name: clearRefreshTimer
methods.description: Clears the scheduled refresh timer if set.

methods.name: listLikePrimary
methods.description: Extracts primary model name from a ModelListLike value.

methods.name: listLikeFallbacks
methods.description: Extracts fallback model names from a ModelListLike value.

methods.name: parseNumberString
methods.description: Parses a string or number into a finite number, or null if invalid.

methods.name: toPricePerMillion
methods.description: Converts a number to a price per million, returning 0 for invalid or negative values.

methods.name: parseOpenRouterPricing
methods.description: Parses raw pricing data into a CachedModelPricing object.

methods.name: canonicalizeOpenRouterProvider
methods.description: Normalizes provider name and applies alias mapping.

methods.name: canonicalizeOpenRouterLookupId
methods.description: Normalizes model IDs, handling special cases for certain providers.

methods.name: buildOpenRouterExactCandidates
methods.description: Builds a list of candidate model IDs for a given ModelRef, considering canonical forms and nested references.

methods.name: addResolvedModelRef
methods.description: Resolves a raw model reference string into a ModelRef and adds it to the refs map.

methods.name: addModelListLike
methods.description: Adds primary and fallback models from a ModelListLike to the refs map.

methods.name: addProviderModelPair
methods.description: Adds a provider-model pair to the refs map after normalization.

methods.name: collectConfiguredModelPricingRefs
methods.description: Collects all model references from the configuration that are relevant for pricing.

methods.name: fetchOpenRouterPricingCatalog
methods.description: Fetches the model pricing catalog from the OpenRouter API.

methods.name: resolveCatalogPricingForRef
methods.description: Resolves pricing info for a model reference from the catalog.

methods.name: scheduleRefresh
methods.description: Schedules the next cache refresh based on TTL.

methods.name: refreshGatewayModelPricingCache
methods.description: Main function to refresh the model pricing cache, fetching catalog data and updating cache.

methods.name: startGatewayModelPricingRefresh
methods.description: Starts periodic cache refresh and returns a function to stop it.

methods.name: getGatewayModelPricingCacheMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata about the current cache state.

methods.name: __resetGatewayModelPricingCacheForTest
methods.description: Resets cache and timers for testing purposes.
